summary: All community.mysql modules and plugins were removed and migrated to ansible.mysql, with redirects provided.
questions: Do I need ansible.mysql to use mysql_user in Ansible 14?

answer_card.title: community.mysql content moved to ansible.mysql
answer_card.answer_md: All modules and plugins were removed from community.mysql and migrated to **ansible.mysql**; redirects are provided. Install `ansible.mysql` and update FQCNs, for example `community.mysql.mysql_info` → `ansible.mysql.mysql_info`.
